主信息(先看这个)Primary information (read this first)

一个真实 2.5B 开源模型(MiniCPM5-2B)的完整 42 层推理,已被编译成确定性 RV32IMA 整数程序:六个固定提示词的下一 token 与 llama.cpp Q4_K_M 全部一致 实测;真实层的 8.49 亿指令轨迹完成承诺 → 二分 → 单步仲裁的本地争议闭环 实测。链本身只做裁判,不做快路径。A real 2.5B open-weights model (MiniCPM5-2B) with all 42 layers of inference compiled into a deterministic RV32IMA integer program: next-token output matches llama.cpp Q4_K_M on all six fixed prompts measured; a real layer's 849M-instruction trace completes the local commitment → bisection → single-step arbitration dispute loop measured. The chain itself is only the referee, never the fast path.

关联上下文Context

TapeOut 已在 BSC 部署 rv32ima 语义机器(跑过 Linux 6.5.12);我们的 12,288 条指令样本与其部署运行时逐字段一致 实测。原生逐指令上链被测得为 2.1×10¹³ gas/token 模型——这正是要走乐观结算的原因。TapeOut has deployed an rv32ima semantic machine on BSC (it has run Linux 6.5.12); our 12,288-instruction sample matches the deployed runtime field-for-field measured. Native per-instruction execution was measured at 2.1×10¹³ gas/token model — which is exactly why optimistic settlement is the path.

A · 一步模型：纯组合网表，一步一个字符 A · One-step model: a purely combinational netlist, one character per step

A0 · 什么是一步模型

定义

能被共识直接执行的最小认知单元：纯组合网表，无 latch，一次 step() 完成全部计算，工作量 = 门数，结构由数据学来。同一份网表既是合约字节也是硅片上的门。

为什么理想

链按门数计费、深度免费、输入走 calldata 几乎免费、latch 每步收费——一步模型把这四条全占了便宜。区块上限（约 29,800 NAND）定义了现役"足够多门"的边界，链的进化会推高它。

不是什么

不是缩小的 LLM（对话/编程差 10⁵ 倍，走乐观结算或 zk 一步验证）；不是查表（v0 恰好用表实现，定义不限于此）；不是智能本身——它是反射弧，智能在它外面的环境、可塑状态、谱系三个循环里。全文见 ONESTEP.md。

A1 · 续写（不是聊天：每条回复 = 网表按采样续写 40–80 字符）

v0.1 网表用 8 个随机输入位在网表内采样：高 5 位选回退深度（随机字节 0 = 完整链 = 贪心），低 3 位在条目的 top-1/top-2 或等质量的一元桶里选。质量仍是 3–4 阶 n-gram 水平。链上时随机字节取区块哈希的一个字节；烧到你的 CPU 后，这里的每一步改为真实 eth_call。

A2 · 它是怎么工作的

编码

最近 32 个字符，最旧在低位：槽 s 的第 j 位 = 输入位 s×6+j；随机字节的第 j 位 = 输入位 192+j。64 符号字母表：空格、a–z、0–9、常见标点、换行，其余保留。输出 6 位 = 下一字符编码，bit 0 在前。

网表

官方 7 字节记录：NAND 操作码 + 两个 24 位线号。线 0 = 假、线 1 = 真、线 2…193 = 输入，之后每条记录一根线；最后 6 条记录的线是输出（last_outs）。本页的 JS 就是按这个定义逐条求值。

为什么一步

没有 latch、没有循环，全部工作量就是门数。链上一步的 gas 只看门数，深度免费；输入 192 位走 calldata 只要几百 gas。

A4 · 边界（诚实）

  • 不是聊天模型：无状态、不学习、只做下一字符预测；质量在 3–4 阶 n-gram 水平。
  • 训练语料 TinyShakespeare（约 1 MB），90/10 切分；字母表折叠大小写与未知字符。
  • 未烧录到 BSC：本页所有结果来自浏览器内求值；gas 来自本地部署的官方 CPU 字节码（eth-tester），未在 BSC 发任何交易。
  • eth_call 不受区块 gas 上限约束（85.7M 的调用照常返回），所以"一步可达"的真实边界是交易：37k 版步 85.6M、烧 109M 都超 68.4M；未注册的 cid 直接回退。

烧录后用一行命令复现一步：cast call <CPU> "step(uint256,bytes,bytes)" <circuitId> 0x <packed 192-bit context> --rpc-url https://bsc-rpc.publicnode.com（circuitId 与打包工具由 H 的 burn kit 给出）。

1 · 一分钟版本1 · One-minute version

⚠“第一个”的确切含义:指第一个在链上 RISC-V 语义体系内完成端到端可仲裁验证的真实 LLM 推理闭环(本地验证,未上链部署)。不是“模型在链上跑出 token”,也不是“链上已可结算”。未证明的部分见右栏与 §5.4。What “first” means exactly: the first real-LLM inference loop verified end-to-end within an on-chain RISC-V semantic framework (locally verified, not deployed on-chain). Not “the model produces tokens on-chain”, and not “settleable on-chain today”. What remains unproven: the right column and §5.4.

未证明 / 边界Unproven / boundaries

  • 未部署任何合约到链上;TraceGame/BoundedMini 是本地原型,无债券、无数据可用性(DA)、无任务授权。No contract has been deployed on-chain; TraceGame/BoundedMini are local prototypes — no bonds, no data availability (DA), no job authorization.
  • 6/6 是窄接受集:不是 logits 逐位一致、不是长上下文质量、不是多 token 生成一致性、不是 BF16 位等价。6/6 is a narrow acceptance set: not bitwise logits equality, not long-context quality, not multi-token generation agreement, not BF16 bit-equivalence.
  • 整模型 201 亿指令没有在 EVM 里重放;EVM 验证只覆盖 bounded 窗口样本。The full-model 20.1B instructions have not been replayed in the EVM; EVM verification covers bounded window samples only.
  • 16 MB 机器地址空间放不下一层权重(23,040 页 > 16,384):分页调度是协议必需,不是免费外部预言机。The 16 MB machine address space cannot hold one layer’s weights (23,040 pages > 16,384): weight paging is a protocol necessity, not a free external oracle.
  • 原生费用回归在稀疏/大批次负载上外推超出拟合范围;乐观费用多为设计估计。The native-cost regression extrapolates beyond its fit range on sparse/large-batch loads; optimistic costs are mostly design estimates.
  • 诚实且在线的挑战者是必要条件;承诺本身不是正确性证明。An honest, online challenger is a necessary condition; a commitment by itself is not a proof of correctness.

3 · 工程实现:三层结构3 · Engineering implementation: three layers

3.1 整数内核:为什么与怎么做3.1 The integer kernel: why and how

为什么必须整数:仲裁要求“任何人重放都得到同一结果”。浮点(GGUF 的实际执行路径)跨平台/跨版本不保证位精确,无法作为争议标的;整数运算才是可重放、可承诺、可在链上单步核对的执行格式。这不是近似妥协——量化契约被冻结后,它就是该模型的一个精确算术定义。Why integers are mandatory: arbitration requires “anyone replaying gets the same result”. Floating point (the GGUF execution path) is not guaranteed bit-exact across platforms/versions and cannot be the subject of a dispute; integer arithmetic is the replayable, committable, single-step-checkable execution format. This is not an approximation compromise — once the quantization contract is frozen, it is an exact arithmetic definition of this model.

冻结的 group32 线性量化契约(W4×A8,线性 group32 linear-Q24)The frozen group32 linear quantization contract (W4×A8, linear group32 linear-Q24)
对象Object规则Rule
权重 WWeights W每 32 个一组:scaleQ24 = max(1, round(max|w|/7 × 2²⁴));量化到有符号 int4 [−7,7],最近邻、平局远离零Per 32 weights: scaleQ24 = max(1, round(max|w|/7 × 2²⁴)); quantized to signed int4 [−7,7], nearest, ties away from zero

量化方案的演化是实测淘汰出来的:行级 2 的幂量化只对 1/3 单 token 提示词一致;group32 2 的幂 0/3 与 1/3;改为线性 group scale 并修正 SiLU 正尾后 6/6。失败方案的 JSON 全部保留,未从失败推断任何表示能力上限。The quantization scheme was evolved by measured elimination: row-level power-of-two agreed on only 1/3 single-token prompts; group32 power-of-two 0/3 and 1/3; linear group scale plus the SiLU positive-tail fix reached 6/6. Failed-scheme JSONs are all retained; no representational upper bound was inferred from failures.

3.2 执行层:分页的必然性3.2 Execution layer: paging is inevitable

模型以 RV32IMA guest 程序运行,宿主按层/head 调用并供应只读权重 bank。一个 token 平均 20,104,183,818 条指令 实测,折合 8.94 指令/稠密 MAC(含 guest 控制流)。关键约束:机器地址空间 16 MB(16,384 页)放不下哪怕一层的均匀 int4 权重(23,040 页);当前 linear32 每层权重/尺度占 28,800 页。因此权重换页是协议必需:bank 加载被定义为显式“外部输入转换”而非普通指令,由独立的 bank 验证器认证(成员资格、调度/游标、零尾、ACK)——14 个真实 bank 边界、107,534 次转换全部通过 实测。The model runs as an RV32IMA guest program; the host calls it per layer/head and supplies read-only weight banks. One token averages 20,104,183,818 instructions measured — 8.94 instructions per dense MAC (incl. guest control flow). Key constraint: the machine’s 16 MB address space (16,384 pages) cannot hold even one layer’s uniform int4 weights (23,040 pages); the current linear32 layer’s weights/scales take 28,800 pages. Weight paging is therefore a protocol necessity: bank loads are defined as explicit “external input transitions” rather than ordinary instructions, authenticated by an independent bank verifier (membership, schedule/cursor, zero tail, ACK) — 14 real bank boundaries, all 107,534 transitions pass measured.

3.3 结算层:承诺 → 二分 → 单步3.3 Settlement layer: commitment → bisection → single step

状态定义(224 字节/检查点):32 个寄存器 + 16 个 CSR(192 B,CPU48 字段小端)+ 内存 Merkle 根(32 B)。叶子为域分离 Keccak,绑定检查点序号、执行上下文(代码/模型 bank 集/初始 RAM 与 token/量化表/零中断环境)。全量状态要 4.503 TB/token——所以只持久化8192 指令区间检查点(约 549.7 MB/token),承诺层级为 token → layer → 算子/bank → 区间;发生争议时只物化被争议区间的重放输入。State definition (224 bytes/checkpoint): 32 registers + 16 CSRs (192 B, CPU48 fields little-endian) + memory Merkle root (32 B). Leaves are domain-separated Keccak binding the checkpoint index and execution context (code / model bank set / initial RAM & tokens / quant tables / zero-interrupt environment). Full state would be 4.503 TB/token — so only 8192-instruction interval checkpoints are persisted (≈549.7 MB/token), with commitment hierarchy token → layer → operator/bank → interval; on dispute, only the disputed interval’s replay inputs are materialized.

二分:粗层 17 轮收敛到一个 8192 指令区间,内层 13 轮收敛到一条指令(真实案例合计 30 轮 实测)。终点是一条真实乘法 0x03698b33:本地 pinned-mini 仲裁器重建其认证代码页、执行单条指令、拒绝错误事后状态;缺页与错根见证均被拒。单步仲裁器(BoundedMini.sol,runtime 8,366 字节)接受 192 B CPU + 内存根 + ≤3 页排序见证,执行一条 mini 语义指令(RV32I/M/A、CSR、陷阱、WFI;MMIO 窗口显式 revert),返回事后 CPU/根/状态与 keccak("state-v1"‖context‖CPU‖root)。Bisection: 17 coarse rounds converge to one 8192-instruction interval, 13 inner rounds to a single instruction (30 rounds total in the real case measured). The endpoint is a real MUL 0x03698b33: the local pinned-mini arbiter rebuilds its authenticated code page, executes one instruction, and rejects the false post-state; missing-page and wrong-root witnesses are both rejected. The single-step arbiter (BoundedMini.sol, runtime 8,366 bytes) accepts 192 B CPU + memory root + ≤3 sorted page witnesses, executes one mini-semantic instruction (RV32I/M/A, CSRs, traps, WFI; MMIO windows explicitly revert), and returns post CPU/root/state with keccak("state-v1"‖context‖CPU‖root).

执行冻结契约的一组单点积:同一输入永远得到同一输出——这就是争议可重放的原因。示例值为示意;pinned 事实:真实 “Hello” layer0 Q 投影行(2,048 项、64 组)在 RTL 与 routed IHP 门级网表上重放 36,866 个仿真时钟,得 Q12 −1258Executes one dot product under the frozen contract: the same inputs always give the same output — that is why disputes are replayable. 5.2 一个乐观任务的生命周期(设计 + 本地原型行为)5.2 The lifecycle of an optimistic job (design + local-prototype behavior)

  1. 提交 job 与轨迹承诺Submit the job and trace commitment

    执行方先链下跑整数内核,发布:模型修订/量化表哈希、程序哈希、输入 token 序列、上下文、轨迹长度、顶层 Merkle 根。本地原型中 open 实测 362,216 gas(含加入)。The executor first runs the integer kernel off-chain, then publishes: model revision / quant-table hashes, program hash, input token sequence, context, trace length, and the top-level Merkle root. In the local prototype, open measured 362,216 gas (incl. join). 生产缺口:任务授权与债券未实现。Production gap: job authorization and bonds unimplemented.

  2. 挑战窗口(设计 7 天)Challenge window (7 days by design)

    任一合格挑战者加入。加入后每方有 1 天累计响应预算,只在自己的回合扣减;超时判负。至少一个诚实、在线的挑战者是必要条件——承诺不是正确性证明。Any eligible challenger joins. After joining, each side has a 1-day cumulative response budget, charged only on its own turns; timeout loses. At least one honest, online challenger is necessary — a commitment is not a proof of correctness.

  3. 二分交互(实测每轮 ~126k gas)Bisection interaction (~126k gas per round, measured)

    双方交替对区间中点给出事后状态哈希;不一致的一半成为新区间。真实 MLP 轨迹 11 轮收敛到指令 1478;真实 MiniCPM 层 17+13 轮收敛到一条乘法。每轮 gas 实测 125,588–130,675(MLP 口径)。The two sides alternately post post-state hashes at interval midpoints; the mismatching half becomes the new interval. The real MLP trace converges in 11 rounds to instruction 1478; the real MiniCPM layer in 17+13 rounds to one MUL. Per-round gas measured 125,588–130,675 (MLP basis).

  4. 单步仲裁(实测 80,520 gas)Single-step arbitration (80,520 gas, measured)

    分歧压缩到一条指令后,争议方提交 ≤3 页排序见证 + 192 B CPU + 内存根;BoundedMini 认证前像、执行一条指令、更新共享 Merkle 分支、返回事后哈希。缺页/错根/短 CPU/MMIO 全部拒绝。35 层级全争议预算 6.62–7.04M gas(模型)。Once the disagreement is compressed to one instruction, the disputing side submits ≤3 sorted page witnesses + 192 B CPU + memory root; BoundedMini authenticates the preimage, executes one instruction, updates the shared Merkle branch, and returns the post hash. Missing page / wrong root / short CPU / MMIO are all rejected. The 35-level full-dispute budget is 6.62–7.04M gas (model).

  5. 结算Settlement

    裁决写入游戏合约,诚实方获得债券与参与激励(设计)。未实现:支付/输出接受耦合、DA、多挑战者策略。7 天挑战期主导最终性——吞吐来自链下,最终性来自链上。The ruling is written into the game contract; the honest side receives bonds and participation incentives (design). Unimplemented: payment/output-acceptance coupling, DA, multi-challenger policy. The 7-day challenge window governs finality — throughput comes from off-chain, finality from on-chain.

5.4 边界(必读)5.4 Boundaries (must read)

⚠本页一切“链上”能力均为本地验证:零笔交易、零部署、零 burn。把它当成生产系统前,以下每一项都是门槛而非细节。Every “on-chain” capability on this page is locally verified: zero transactions, zero deployments, zero burns. Before treating it as a production system, each item below is a gate, not a detail.
  • 协议缺口:任务授权(谁允许初始化该 job)、债券/支付、DA、多挑战者策略、生产级挑战管理器——均未实现。Protocol gaps: job authorization (who may initialize a job), bonds/payments, DA, multi-challenger policy, production challenge manager — none implemented.
  • 语义缺口:单步仲裁器只实现 elapsed=0 的 RAM 配置;定时器/UART/syscon/MMIO 需要版本化环境配置(裁判核路线上的 env-ram/env-mmio 原型正在补)。Semantic gaps: the single-step arbiter implements only the elapsed=0 RAM profile; timers/UART/syscon/MMIO need a versioned environment profile (env-ram/env-mmio prototypes are being filled in on the referee-core lane).
  • 保真缺口:6/6 是窄接受集;缓存 decode、长上下文、对抗性 scale/离群值、整数溢出界未验证。注意力工作区上限 16 位置。Fidelity gaps: 6/6 is a narrow acceptance set; cached decode, long contexts, adversarial scales/outliers, integer-overflow bounds unverified. Attention workspace cap is 16 positions.
  • 费用口径:原生回归在稀疏/大页银行负载上外推;快乐路径 150–300k 是设计估计,同深度实测“开题+超时”为 365,941。Cost basis: the native regression extrapolates on sparse/large-page-bank loads; the 150–300k happy path is a design estimate — the same-depth measured “open+timeout” is 365,941.
  • 机器缺口:现有已部署机器的 tick 是属主可变状态接口,不是公开无状态仲裁器;TapeOut 需要暴露/许可有界状态见证的单步执行。Machine gaps: the deployed machine’s tick is an owner-mutable stateful interface, not a public stateless arbiter; TapeOut needs to expose/permit bounded-state-witness single-step execution.
  • 信任缺口:芯片输出不自证;小电路可走链上 step() 重放,大模型必须依赖健全的争议协议与诚实挑战者。Trust gaps: a chip’s output is not self-certifying; small circuits can replay via on-chain step(), large models must rely on a sound dispute protocol and honest challengers.

中文结论(与仓库报告一致):完整 42 层整数程序已运行,六个固定提示词的下一 token 与真实 GGUF 一致;真实层的分层轨迹、二分与本地单步仲裁已通过。推荐继续做权重分页认证与无状态仲裁器,不推荐把现有解释器逐指令运行整个模型当成产品路径。微型芯片已有实际权重切片的 RTL/门级证据;它不包含完整 MiniCPM,也不自动产生可在 BSC 结算的证明。Conclusion (consistent with the repo reports): the full 42-layer integer program has run; the next tokens of six fixed prompts match the real GGUF; the real layer’s hierarchical trace, bisection, and local single-step arbitration have passed. Recommended next: weight-paging authentication and the stateless arbiter; not recommended: running the whole model instruction-by-instruction through the existing interpreter as the product path. The micro-chip has RTL/gate-level evidence on a real weight slice; it does not contain the full MiniCPM and does not automatically produce a BSC-settleable proof.
